paragraphs: Mom drives Tom and Lily to a show. It is a drawing show at school. They see a sign for the car park. It says: "Car park." Mom drives in. Tom sees a new sign. It says: "Drawing show. This way." The children go to the hall.

There are many pictures in the hall. Lily looks at a big green frog. "I like this frog!" she says. Tom sees a giraffe. It is yellow and brown. Tom has an apple in his hand. Then he sees a sign. It says: "No food or drink." Tom puts the apple in his bag.

Ben is outside with a ball. A sign next to him says: "Catch the ball." "Can you catch?" asks Ben. "Yes, I can," says Lily. Ben throws the ball to Lily. Lily catches it with two hands. "Well done!" says Ben. Mom smiles at Tom and Lily. It is a fun day.
